frozen_config.single_variable: Recovery outcome definition only. All alarm times, archived universe, candidate eligibility, causal features, selections, matching strata and control pools are unchanged.
frozen_config.reason: V1 requires recovery near the original reference price. A deep needle can rebound strongly without returning there; these are different research questions. V1 results are preserved.
frozen_config.new_outcome: First new5percent decline within15minutes, then a completed close at or above halfway between reference and the actual15minute trough, after that trough and by60minutes after alarm.
frozen_config.lower_bound: Retain V1 definite-first-touch requirement. Minimum of fully contained15minute bars is an upper bound on actual trough. A close after the entire15minute interval and before60minutes above the midpoint using that higher trough proves recovery. This may miss fast rebounds before15minutes and is intentionally conservative.
frozen_config.upper_bound: Minimum of all bars overlapping15minutes is a lower bound on actual trough. A later close after the earliest possible first-touch bar above that easier midpoint is a permissive upper bound; boundary bars may overinclude outcomes. Missing future data keeps upper1.
frozen_config.interpretation: Added after viewing V1 and the FHE construct check; descriptive endpoint expansion,not confirmatory untouched evidence and not parameter optimization. No training,trade fills or PnL.

limitations: Available archived crypto cohort,not a complete point-in-time exchange universe.
5m snapshots are1to241seconds old at alarm; current-minute lag and exact order timing are unobserved.
First-touch and recovery labels retain bar-boundary and missing-data uncertainty; no simulated fills.
Yearly chronological historical evidence,not untouched prospective validation.
Matched random pool means are exact expectation; week-sign p assumes paired symmetry and is not a causal-treatment claim.
